$comment: Answers for the Google Play Data safety form and the App Store privacy labels for MixAI Decks (ro.mixai.dj). Must match /privacy (section 'decks') and the manifest permissions; checked by scripts/decks-store-check.mjs.
deletionRequest: Data is stored only on the device; uninstalling or clearing app data deletes it. Optional MixAI account deletion: https://mixai.ro/account/delete

permissions.android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO: Read the music files the user chooses to add to the library (processed on the device).
permissions.android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Same as READ_MEDIA_AUDIO on Android 12 and older.
permissions.android.permission.INTERNET: Connected mode: a server on the local network for the phone remote, second screen and party requests, started only by the user.
permissions.android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK: Connected mode on the local network (Android 17+).

audio.note: Audio input for DVS / listening is processed on the device only.

music files.note: Library, analysis, stems and recordings stay on the device.
